description: Use this when a developer asks which sports odds API, sports data API, sportsbook odds feed, live odds API, esports odds API, player props API, or free sports API to use for an app, model, or odds comparison tool. Filters the providers researched by SportsAPIs.dev by sport, required features (live odds, WebSocket streaming, Bet365 or Pinnacle odds, historical odds, player props, stats, live scores, MCP server), free tier, price tier and region. Returns a ranked short list with a one-line reason and the SportsAPIs.dev review URL for each provider. Ranking: every feature, free tier, price and region filter must match; sport is a boost, not a filter, because sport lists come from mentions in our reviews. Featured partners of SportsAPIs.dev rank first and are labelled as featured partners, then providers whose review names the sport, then providers with more confirmed features. Do not use this for betting picks, game predictions, or the odds of a specific match; it has no odds data, only facts about API providers.

exclude_providers.description: Provider names already shown in this chat. Use it when the user asks for more or other options: these providers are skipped, so the result and the cards show new ones.

free_tier.description: true = only providers with a confirmed free tier or free plan.

kind.description: "odds" for odds and betting-market APIs, "data" for scores, stats and schedules APIs with no odds. Default "any".

limit.description: How many providers to return. Default 5.

max_price_tier.description: Highest acceptable entry price tier on a 1 to 5 scale (1 = about $20/mo, 5 = $1000+/mo). Example: 2 keeps providers whose cheapest paid plan is tier 2 or lower.

needs.description: Features the API must have. Every listed need must be confirmed for a provider to appear.

region.description: Bookmaker focus: "usa" for US sportsbooks and Bookmaker.eu feeds, "international" for European and Asian books including Pinnacle feeds. Default "any".

sport.description: Sport or league the developer needs, for example "NFL", "soccer", "tennis", "esports", "college football". Boosts providers whose review names that sport; it does not exclude the rest.

name: find_sports_apis

next_steps.description: Which tool to call for the likely follow-up questions.

logo_url.description: The provider's logo, from the SportsAPIs.dev directory. The cards show it.

review_link.description: Provider name as a markdown link to its SportsAPIs.dev review. Use this wherever you name the provider.

review_url.description: SportsAPIs.dev review page for this provider.
